name: SacCubing XXI 2025
information: ### Registration is currently full and the waitlist is now closed. We will no longer be accepting anymore competitors onto the waitlist for this competition. #### Competitors from the waitlist will be accepted until Friday, September 19, 2025 at 5:00 PM, after which point all waitlisted competitors will not be able to compete. Competitors who do not make it off the waitlist will receive full refunds. Please click the [Waitlist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXXI2025#64129-waitlist) tab for more details. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzYyMDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b461cbfe0cad33e2120f14293fe68e84c3bb5009/sac_transparent%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) #### SacCubing returns with our 21st iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot! * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.
